The '''Wardens of the Sky''' were a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using organization that operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], keeping the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|spacelanes]] safe.

==Philosophy and beliefs==
The Wardens believed that it was their responsibility to use their knowledge of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to make [[Hyperspace route/Legends|spacelanes]] safe for everyone to travel on. They believed that everyone had a right to be able to travel to space and so would do such things as fight [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or help [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], who they believed were defying the tyrants of the spacelanes. They had no central organization and each Warden operated alone, patrolling spacelanes and watching out for travelers who needed help. From time to time, Wardens would encounter other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] travelers and if the Warden believed they had potential, would approach such Force users and offer to take them as an apprentice. After completing training as an apprentice, the student would leave to patrol the spacelanes alone.

The Wardens used subtle methods and would never reveal their true allegiance. They only acted in overt ways if it was truly necessary. They would walk among the crowds of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], where they blended in, as they appeared to be just ordinary space travelers. Indeed many Wardens were. It was commonplace for Wardens to work on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] or [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]], as this gave them opportunities to patrol a section of space while appearing just to be an ordinary crew member.

Believing that firing [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] on board starships was dangerous, the Wardens were masters of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. They developed a unique fighting style that involved a combination of Force techniques and martial arts.

==History==
During the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]], which had been responsible for monitoring the spacelanes, became discredited. A Force-sensitive [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] began to patrol the spacelanes instead, to try and stop anyone who made intergalactic travel difficult for ordinary people. Eventually, he found and trained other Force-sensitives, and they became the first Wardens of the Sky.

Over time, the Wardens came to be regarded as myth, told in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] by space pilots. This anonymity helped them to evade detection by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and later, by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
